learning_objective: The learner can describe how memory systems manage information exceeding a model's maximum context length to support RAG and agent applications.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing that a model's internal knowledge changes with every query rather than only when the model is updated.
Assuming that short-term memory (context) persists across different tasks or queries when it does not.
Thinking FIFO is the only memory management strategy, ignoring retention of N last messages or tokens.
